events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: The Herbert-to-Helix deal is getting louder in hindsight. I've now spoken to three people who were aware talks were happening well before the transaction filed, and the consensus is that Adam gave up more than the headline suggests. Stroud alone was meaningful. The 2028 first on top of it is what makes this a real cost.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Helix adding Herbert and STILL holding Gyllenborg and Allen and Mitchell — that roster is either a dynasty contender or an overcrowded bus with no driver. I genuinely do not know which. That uncertainty alone should move the stock and I'm watching very carefully.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Fronge relocated to Havana. Zero pick liquidity. Took on Croskey-Merritt and Stroud and a future first in exchange for Herbert. Let me ask the room a simple question: what exactly is ForgeHammer building toward, and does Fronge know the answer?

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Everyone is very excited about Helix right now and I understand it. I also said in the preseason that Adam's model-driven approach would eventually force him into an overpay to close the gap. A 2028 first plus Stroud for Herbert is the overpay. The turnaround is real. The price was too high. Both can be true.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: ForgeHammer got Stroud, got Croskey-Merritt, got a 2028 first-rounder, and is operating out of Havana. I don't fully understand the business model but I respect the audacity of it. Fronge is doing Fronge things and somehow it is working out for Fronge.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: People keep debating whether Herbert or Stroud is the better asset and missing what actually matters here: Helix is now a superflex squad with Herbert locked in as the guy and actual RB depth behind him with Mitchell. That roster construction is coherent in a way it wasn't three months ago. Give the model some credit.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Wingard shipped out Keaton Mitchell for a 2028 third and is sitting on a mountain of future capital that the exchange is actively discounting. At some point the picks have to become players. Sovereign Draft Reserve is the most fascinating love-it-or-leave-it roster construction story in this league and we are not talking about it enough.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Tomorrow's Exchange Report has the Herbert trade, the Deepwater situation, and whatever Vance has decided to scream about this week. Vivienne says we're keeping the Deepwater segment to eight minutes. I'll believe it when I see it.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Croskey-Merritt goes to Havana, Herbert goes to the model guy, and a 2028 first disappears into the ether. I have watched this league for five minutes and I already know Wingard is going to turn that third-rounder into something unhinged. I need a segment on this immediately.
